Controls

Left stick moves. Drag anywhere on the screen (or on Fire) to look.
Keys · click one, then press the new key (Esc cancels)
Picking a key that is already in use swaps the two.

WASDMove SpaceJump (press again in mid-air to double jump) CCrouch (press again to stand) MouseLook (click the game to lock)
Fight
Left clickFire (aims down sights while held; snipers: hold to scope, let go to fire)Punch (34) / bat swing (50) 1 2Gun / bat Falling punch20 damage, both knocked back, they're stunned 1s EThrow a shop grenade if you have one, otherwise use your lethal (hold to aim, release to throw; lays a mine) ShopWalk up to the shop in the middle: it goes bing and gives you a random pickup (30s cooldown)
When you're downed
CrawlSlowly; you take full damage while down ReviveAutomatic after 5 seconds (2.5 with a teammate beside you), back up with whatever downed health you have left Left clickTag an enemy: red outline for 3s 2v2If your teammate is out while you're down, you're out too
